newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Pao de Acucar begun as hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Pao de Acucar begun as hold.

text.p: -- UBS Securities said it initiated coverage of Brazilian supermarket chain Companhia Brasileira de Distribuicao, widely known as Pao de Acucar, with a hold rating.
-- It said its 12-month price target on the stock is $21.60.
-- It said in a report it expects Pao de Acucar earnings to grow through increased productivity and efficiency and moderate sales area expansion.
-- Although it likes CBD as an operator, UBS Securities said it finds "the valuation is not currently compelling."
-- "CBD trades at a 38 percent discount in P/97E to its peers in Latin America, but a much smaller discount in other measures," it said.
-- Pao de Acucar operates 222 retail outlets in Brazil.
-- The company's preferred stock traded at 19.10 reais, off 1.54 percent, at 1715 local/1915 GMT on the Sao Paulo bourse.
